xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #3334

plan.title: bug(verify-ac,check): empty-resolution soft pass presents as green run - unstamped acceptance yields a fail-open done-gate that licenses stopping; scope:activate must refuse acceptance-shaped narratives without plan.acceptance

narratives.Description: Empty verify-ac soft pass presents as green run; refuse unstamped acceptance-shaped narratives.
narratives.Overview: Empty verify-ac resolution must not present as a green run when the project has no suite floor. scope-activate refuses acceptance-shaped narratives without plan.acceptance. Telemetry distinguishes verified-pass from empty-pass. Closes issue 3334.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator of a consumer done-gate, I want empty unstamped acceptance to be a distinct non-green outcome, so that check cannot license stopping on nothing.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Fail closed on empty resolution without a suite floor. Refuse activate when narratives carry Test or AcceptanceCriteria or Verification without plan.acceptance. Emit acceptance telemetry. Do not rewrite 3322 oracle integrity.

narrative.Acceptance: A brief with prose acceptance in narratives and no plan.acceptance cannot pass scope:activate; one remediation string.
verify:ac on zero commands in a no-suite-floor project is non-zero or a visibly distinct non-run through check, never a bare green run.
Run summary distinguishes verified-pass from empty-pass; CHANGELOG cites #3334.
